description: Scan of all 81 Robinhood-tradable coins for the two WASHED SETUP shapes (daily uptrend + washed-out 5-minute tape): every hit with GO, fuel multiple vs BTC, grade and room, plus the setup column for the full universe. Recomputed about every 5 minutes, 24/7. Shapes were backtest-confirmed on equities and are forward-graded on crypto (disclosed per read). Live intraday version. Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data. Agents with an x402 wallet can also pay per call. Without a subscription or an x402 wallet it returns a PaymentRequired object and no data.
name: get_crypto_setups_live
